name: shiny-button
title: Shiny Button
description: Button with a rotating conic-gradient border, masked dot pattern, and inner shimmer that intensifies on hover

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Button fill colour inside the animated border.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Colour of the rotating border arc, inner shimmer, and hover glow.

props.name: accentSoftColor
props.description: Shine colour the border eases into while hovered.

props.name: sweepDuration
props.description: Seconds for one full rotation of the border gradient.

props.name: easeDuration
props.description: Seconds for the hover ease into the wider, brighter border.

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Resting width of the bright border arc, as a percentage.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels; 32 and above render as a full pill at the default height.

props.name: showSpeckle
props.description: Shows the masked dot pattern layer.

props.name: speckleOpacity
props.description: Strength of the dot pattern layer.
